caption: The drawing features a two-handled metal cup centered on a light beige or off-white background. The cup is rendered in shades of gray, with a smooth, reflective surface and ornate decorations on its body. It is symmetrical, with two large, looping handles extending from either side and curling outward. The body of the cup is adorned with three prominent vertical sections, each containing a raised, stylized leaf motif with spiral accents at the bottom. At the upper center of the cup, there is an inscription that reads “GVAV.” The drawing is framed by a single, thin rectangular border. In the lower right corner of the image, outside the border, there is a signature reading “A. Reina.”
title: Silver Wine Taster
